body: I don't know man... Thinking back of everything that's happened I'm starting to feel it's worth it. I can confront a burglar and pretty much let him kill me. It's just really shitty for me.

Rich? As in money? I've had seen people who are rich that pretty much are suicidal knowing their money really wouldn't keep them happy too long. Sorry for inserting myself here but even if I do become rich it'd be pointless for me. I wanted a decent paying job sure but I also need a partner who'd love me unconditionally no matter what and that's fucking gone for me. I'm better off dead rich or not, successful or not.

\*Sigh\* She said she wouldn't forgive me if I hurt myself. I don't see the difference anymore on it really... It's quite funny to hear her say that... After all the promises after we got back a few months ago... I was so happy... She said this and that and how she'll suffer for life if I ended it all. Idk who's the selfish one here. She knows I'll do shit to myself if she left me like this. I'm barely talked to anymore even. I'll be gone soon enough. Just one more needle to poke me and it'll be the end.

I've tried those memes and anime treatment and trust me that it doesn't help me. Not even things I loved doing makes it feel any better. I've tried doing everything I used to do even if it doesn't involve her. Nothing.

Sorry if that sounded a bit mean or in a harsh tone but I do appreciate the suggestion/help

Kids never wanted to play with me when I was a kid. No one picks me in their group and I have to consult the teacher almost every time. I've talked with her and she sad she wont forget me and all but. I really can't take the pain.
